memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: 'The priest shall bring her and have her stand before the Lord. Then he shall take some holy water in a clay jar and put some dust from the tabernacle floor into the water. After the priest has had the woman stand before the Lord, he shall loosen her hair and place in her hands the reminder-offering, the grain offering for jealousy, while he himself holds the bitter water that brings a curse.' - Num 5:16-18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The woman is brought to stand "before the Lord." The whole procedure that follows — the holy water, the dust, the offering — is designed to place the outcome entirely in God's hands, not the husband's. This is the heart of the matter: the verdict belongs to God alone.

We may find the ritual strange, and it is not something practised today. But consider what it accomplished in that time and place. A woman accused only on suspicion would normally have been at the mercy of an angry man. Here, instead, she stands before God, and God alone will judge. No human being gets to condemn her on a hunch.

This reveals something true about God's character that never changes: He is the righteous Judge who sees what no human eye can see. He does not judge by appearances or by suspicion; He judges truly (1 Sam 16:7). Matters too tangled for human courts are safe in His hands.

There is deep comfort in this for anyone who has been wrongly accused or misunderstood. You may not be able to prove your innocence to everyone. People may believe the worst about you. But there is a Judge who sees the truth perfectly, and one day He will bring everything into the light.

Leave your reputation and your unresolved matters in God's hands. He judges rightly, and He can be trusted with what you cannot control.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Have you been wrongly accused or misunderstood?
- How does it comfort you that God judges truly, not by appearances?
- Can you leave an unresolved matter in God's hands today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Righteous Father, You see what others cannot and judge what I cannot. I place my unresolved matters and my reputation in Your faithful hands. Amen.
